description: One-call 14-field valuation snapshot for one A-share: PE / PE-TTM / PB / PS / PS-TTM, total/float/free share, total/circ market cap, turnover rate (raw & float), volume ratio, dividend yield (last-year & TTM). Computed in-house from raw market data rather than passed through from a vendor feed, and cross-checked against an independent reference. Use `date` to fetch a historical snapshot; omit for real-time.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

date.description: Trade date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for real-time snapshot

name: financials_quote_snapshot
